newsitem.title: USA: Canadian July spot gas dips 10-15 cts below June 1.
newsitem.headline: Canadian July spot gas dips 10-15 cts below June 1.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices for July 1 fell about 10-15 cents below June indices Friday following NYMEX's decline toward July expiry on Thursday, market sources said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub for both weekend and July 1 gas were in convergence around C$1.50 per gigajoule, traders said.
NYMEX's July Henry Hub gas futures expired Thursday 8.2 cents lower at $2.145, while August dipped to a low of $2.105 earlier today.
